originalEnglish:
The journey began in a quiet forest where the air was crisp and the leaves rustled with a low, rhythmic thrum. My mother, a seasoned traveler, had been here for years, carrying a leather-bound notebook filled with maps and handwritten notes on every possible route she encountered. She taught me that the most profound departure is not leaving a city, but choosing a path that honors your soul rather than merely following the crowd.

As I packed my bag, I found myself standing before a towering oak tree whose branches reached so high they seemed to touch the sky. The wind carried the scent of pine and earth, a mixture that made me feel both grounded and awake. I realized then that true travel lies in the silence between words; it is the quiet moment when you listen to your own thoughts without rushing them forward. With this new perspective, my first meaningful trip was not just a destination, but an alchemy of experience.
